title: Future Games Show at gamescom 2026 Delivers 13 World Premieres and a Packed Slate of Release Updates
description: The Future Games Show at gamescom 2026 featured 13 world-premiere trailers alongside new gameplay, demos, and release updates for dozens of upcoming games.
body: The Future Games Show at gamescom 2026 has wrapped with a broad slate of announcements spanning major sequels, new indie projects, release dates, demos, and ==13 world-premiere trailers==. The showcase moved quickly across genres and publishers, with reveals including Wolcen II, Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms, PixelJunk Monsters 3, Breakaway Hockey League, Kingdom 3: Rising Realms, Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern, and Escape from Playtime.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: The Future Games Show logo appears above the gamescom logo against a dark geometric background with red and orange accents.
imageCredit: Future Games Show / gamescom official promotional artwork.

contentBlocks.text: The show used its ==world-premiere slots== to reveal several previously unannounced projects, including Wolcen II, Greak 2: Alliance of the Storms, PixelJunk Monsters 3, Breakaway Hockey League, DNA Nemesis, Kingdom 3: Rising Realms, Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern, and the finale reveal Escape from Playtime.
contentBlocks.heading: Thirteen world premieres anchored the showcase

contentBlocks.text: Alongside the premieres, the broadcast featured ==fresh gameplay and date updates== for games such as Onimusha: Way of the Sword, Serious Sam: Shatterverse, Graveyard Keeper 2, Star Wars: Galactic Racer, Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault, and Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy.
contentBlocks.heading: Existing games also received release dates and new footage

contentBlocks.text: The main Future Games Show was followed by FGS Live From gamescom, extending the event with additional trailers, developer interviews, and more reveals from the Cologne show floor. A separate Best of gamescom broadcast is scheduled to close out the week on ==August 30==.
contentBlocks.heading: FGS Live continued the gamescom coverage
